description: Flip an open GitHub PR between draft and ready-for-review (idempotent; uses the GraphQL mutations, since REST only supports draft at creation)

target_repo.description: GitHub repo that received the PR (e.g., 'simp/pupmod-simp-simplib')

target_branch.description: Base branch of the PR in target_repo

fork_user.description: GitHub user whose fork provides the PR's head branch

fork_branch.description: Head branch of the PR (the session's feature branch)

extra_gem_path.description: Additional gem path to look for ruby gems (e.g., `octokit`)
